template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

cut_contour.note: Proposal: the source has no die line. The sticker is drawn with all four corners rounded at the header radius (4.63 mm). To be confirmed by the printer.

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of one sticker of the source sheet, cut out with 1.5 mm margin (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
notes: Terminal fault sticker: navy header with the reverse logo, 'Storing?' and the phone number in black (Ubuntu), then 'Automaatnummer' with either a dashed 'plaats sticker hier' field (variant leeg) or a navy bar with the machine number (variant bsg-i1). The text colour in the source is pure black, the template uses PY-Zwart. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
